omnivoice_findings.finding: Discrete masked token generative model predicting categorical distributions over 2048 codebook tokens across 8 RVQ layers at 25Hz.
Iterative unmasking uses confidence ranking penalized by layer ID (layer_penalty_factor = 5.0) prioritizing Layer 0.
Non-destructive token freezing invariant sets previously unmasked tokens to -inf scores, preventing modification.
Inference Golden Baseline operates at num_step=4, guidance_scale=0.0, batch_size=1 on CPU with 6 threads.

auk_findings.finding: AuK is a 1.5B parameter foundational model for unified speech generation and editing based on Continuous Rectified-Flow DiT.
Uses Qwen2.5-Omni-3B MLLM for instruction/text processing and Continuous Latent Audio VAE (128-dim, 50Hz).
AuK-Flash achieves 4-step generation via consistency initialization and task-routed Decoupled DMD without CFG.
AuK is optimized for Chinese (Mandarin, 12 dialects) and English; possesses no native acoustic phonemizer or tonal model for Vietnamese.

speech_skills.skill: Multi-rate resampling, mono normalization, and WAV header integrity validation.
Multi-criteria filtering: SNR >= 14dB, Clipping <= 0.2%, Duration 2.5-15s, Silence <= 30%.
Hierarchical separation of acoustic backbone vs fine harmonic residuals.
In-context reference audio prefixing in transformer attention space.
ASR and SNR based data cleaning of speech training pairs.
Automated SECS measurement via WavLM-TDNN cosine similarity.
Trajectory alignment and non-destructive intermediate state preservation.
CER/WER validation filtering on text-audio training pairs.
Curriculum annealing from teacher-guided warmup to self-rollout exposure.
Decoupled feature-specific loss supervision across representation tiers.
Multi-dimensional objective evaluation harness (SECS + CER + Quality).
CFG=0 operation to prevent variance amplification and acoustic artifacts.
Logit/confidence drop monitoring for early detection of generation failure.
High-pass filtering (>50Hz) and LUFS loudness normalization (-24 LUFS).
Cross-fading across text boundaries and 10ms edge de-clicking fades.

incompatible_components.reason: Incompatible with OmniVoice's discrete RVQ tokens and HiggsAudio vocoder.
Mathematical paradigm mismatch with categorical masked unmasking.
Excessive 3B parameter scale exceeding CPU memory limits and baseline scope.
Severe risk of stripping Vietnamese tone marks and corrupting diacritics.

vietnamese_risks.risk: Corruption of Vietnamese 6 Tones (Ngang, Huyen, Sac, Hoi, Nga, Nang)
vietnamese_risks.cause: Under-weighting Layer 0 acoustic pitch contour or using non-Vietnamese tokenizers.
vietnamese_risks.mitigation: Protect OmniVoice text pipeline; enforce Layer 0 loss weight >= 1.5x; deploy Tone Accuracy minimal pair gate.

vietnamese_risks.cause: Excessive downsampling or rapid unmasking of mid-frequency formant layers (Layers 1-3).
vietnamese_risks.mitigation: Monitor Whisper CER with final consonant decomposition.
